title: Data Engineer-Speech and language Data
description:
**Data Engineer / Analyst — Speech \& Language Data** 





 www.gnani.ai
 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 **Type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Function:** 
 AI Team
 



**About the role** 




 Every speech model we ship is downstream of a decision someone made about data. Which hours got recorded. Which transcripts were trusted. Whether the Tamil test set accidentally shares speakers with the Tamil training set. Whether a number was written as २५ or 25\. Those decisions set the ceiling on what our ASR and TTS models can ever achieve — and no amount of GPU time recovers a corpus that was built carelessly.
 



 Training accurate ASR across 22\+ Indian languages takes tens of thousands of hours of audio. Training TTS voices that sound human takes carefully recorded, tightly aligned, phonetically balanced speech. Right now that data lives across many places and many heads. We want one person to own it.
 



 This role is the data owner for Gnani’s AI team. You source it, clean it, label it, version it, catalogue it, and defend its provenance — and you are the single point of contact when any researcher needs hours, a benchmark, or an answer about where something came from. It is a hands\-on engineering and analysis role with real judgment attached: you will listen to audio, read transcripts, and be the person who notices that something is wrong before a model trains on it.
 



**Core mandate** 




**Sourcing \& acquisition** 




 Find, evaluate, and bring in speech and text data across 22\+ Indian languages — public, licensed, customer, and commissioned
 



**Pipelines \& data quality** 




 Build the cleaning, segmentation, alignment, and validation pipelines that turn raw audio into trainable hours
 



**Annotation \& benchmarks** 




 Own transcription and labelling quality, and maintain the frozen evaluation sets the whole team is judged on
 



**Data ownership \& governance** 




 Be the single point of contact for data — catalogued, versioned, consented, and compliant by default
 



  





**What you’ll drive** 




**Sourcing \& acquisition** 



* Be permanently on the hunt for data — track new public Indic speech and text corpora as they release, evaluate them for quality and licence terms, and bring the good ones in fast
* Know the landscape cold: the AI4Bharat ecosystem (IndicVoices, Kathbath, Shrutilipi, GramVaani, IndicTTS), LIMMITS, SYSPIN, Rasa, Common Voice, FLEURS, and whatever lands next — and maintain an honest view of what each is actually good for
* Assess and onboard customer\-contributed data — what consent covers it, what the DPA permits, what has to be de\-identified before it can be used, and what cannot be used at all
* Spec and manage commissioned data collection and studio recording — script design for phonetic and dialect coverage, speaker recruitment criteria, session QC, and vendor throughput
* Keep a running gap analysis: hours per language, per dialect, per channel, per domain — so the team argues about priorities with numbers instead of impressions



**Pipelines, cleaning \& curation** 



* Build and own the pipelines that turn raw audio into trainable hours — format conversion and resampling, loudness normalisation, VAD\-based segmentation, diarisation, and forced alignment
* Automate quality screening at scale: SNR estimation, clipping and DC offset, truncated utterances, silence\-heavy segments, language\-ID mismatches, and audio–transcript drift
* De\-duplicate seriously — audio fingerprinting and near\-duplicate text detection, so the same recording is not both trained on and evaluated on
* Own the text side, which for Indic data is most of the work: orthographic convention, numeral form, transliteration and romanised code\-switch, punctuation, casing, inverse text normalisation, and lexicon maintenance — inconsistent conventions show up as WER that has nothing to do with the model
* Run large\-scale pseudo\-labelling and weak supervision — transcribe unlabelled audio with existing models, filter on confidence and cross\-model agreement, and route the uncertain cases to human review
* Version and catalogue everything: reproducible dataset snapshots, training manifests, dataset cards recording source, licence, consent basis, and known limitations



**Annotation, listening \& quality** 



* Own transcription and labelling quality end to end — write the annotation guidelines, train annotators against them, and revise them when reality disagrees
* Listen to audio and annotate yourself, as needed. Sampling real data is how you find the problems dashboards hide, and it is part of this job rather than beneath it
* Measure annotation quality properly — gold sets, inter\-annotator agreement, WER between independent transcriptions — and manage vendors on quality and cost per hour, not volume alone
* Build the TTS\-specific quality gates: alignment tightness, transcript fidelity, speaker and style consistency, prosody and emotion tagging, and codec round\-trip checks
* Coordinate listening panels for subjective evaluation (MOS / CMOS / preference tests) — recruitment, screening, sample randomisation, and result analysis



**Benchmarks \& evaluation sets** 



* Own Gnani’s internal benchmark suite for ASR and TTS — curated, frozen, versioned, speaker\-disjoint from training data, and representative across language, dialect, accent, channel, and domain
* Guarantee split hygiene. No test speaker in train, no leaked utterance, no silently mutated eval set — and be willing to block a result that violates it
* Track external and public benchmarks, reproduce them faithfully, and flag when a published comparison is not apples to apples
* Analyse results, not just produce them — slice error by language, speaker, channel, and domain, and tell the team where the corpus is failing them



**Tooling \& internal UIs** 



* Write the Python that holds all of this together — ingestion and processing scripts, validation checks, catalogue tooling, and reporting
* Build small internal web tools with modern coding assistants: annotation and QC interfaces, dataset explorers, audio A/B listening and diffing tools, and demo UIs for internal reviews and customer conversations
* Turn recurring manual work into tooling. If you have done it by hand three times, it should be a script or a screen by the fourth



**Governance, security \& customers** 



* Treat voice data as sensitive PII by default — voice recordings, transcripts, and speaker embeddings, the last of which are biometric data and carry the highest sensitivity
* Build de\-identification and redaction into the pipeline: account and card numbers, Aadhaar and PAN, names, addresses, and health or financial detail out of transcripts before anyone works with them
* Maintain provenance and consent records well enough to survive an audit — what data came from where, under what licence or DPA, retained how long, and deleted on what trigger
* Apply data standards and recognised governance practice to how corpora are documented, accessed, retained, and disposed of — aligned with DPDP and, where relevant, RBI, IRDAI, and HIPAA expectations
* Work with the security team on access control, encryption at rest and in transit, least\-privilege data rooms, and audit logging — and support customer security reviews and data\-handling questions directly



**Being the single point of contact** 



* Be the person the team comes to for data. Take requests from ASR, TTS, LLM, and product, understand what is actually needed, and deliver the right subset with the right metadata
* Communicate clearly and often across a team of researchers and engineers with different needs and different vocabularies, and keep everyone working from one shared picture of what data exists
* Say no when a request would compromise split hygiene, consent, or compliance — and explain why in terms the requester accepts



**Who you are** 




**EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR** 



* 3–6 years in data engineering, data analysis, or ML data work — with real ownership of a dataset that other people depended on
* Strong, practical Python: pandas or polars, scripting, automation, and comfort working with files and pipelines at scale rather than only in notebooks
* Genuine ownership instinct. This role has no one above it to catch a data problem — you are that person, and you should want to be
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the patience to work across several stakeholders with competing data needs
* Careful, detail\-obsessed temperament — the kind of person who spots that two files have subtly different transcript conventions before anyone trains on them



**WHAT MAKES A STANDOUT CANDIDATE** 



* Hands\-on experience with audio or speech data — segmentation, alignment, transcription workflows, or annotation operations
* Fluency in one or more Indian languages beyond English, and an ear for dialect and code\-switching
* Experience running annotation vendors or an in\-house labelling team, including quality measurement and cost management
* Comfort building small web UIs and demos — Streamlit, Gradio, or a lightweight FastAPI plus React app, coding assistants very much welcome
* Exposure to data governance and privacy in a regulated setting — DPDP, consent management, PII redaction, or supporting customer security reviews
* Comfortable operating with high ownership in a fast\-moving, post–Series B environment



**TECHNICAL FLUENCY — A MUST\-HAVE** 



* **Python \& data:** 
 pandas / polars, PyArrow and Parquet, JSONL manifests, SQL, and clean reusable scripting
* **Audio tooling:** 
 ffmpeg, sox, librosa or torchaudio — resampling, segmentation, loudness, and basic signal sanity checks
* **Pipelines \& storage:** 
 object storage, sharded formats for training throughput, workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster), Git, Docker
* **Dataset discipline:** 
 versioning and snapshots, train / dev / test split design, speaker\-disjoint splits, deduplication, dataset documentation
* **Analysis \& reporting:** 
 WER and CER computation and error slicing, coverage and gap reporting, agreement metrics, and dashboards people actually read
* **Nice to have:** 
 NVIDIA NeMo manifest conventions, forced alignment tools, Spark or Ray for large jobs, and basic familiarity with how ASR and TTS models consume data

title: Lead - Data Engineer
description:
The
 ***Lead Data Engineer, Enterprise Data Platform (EDP)***
 is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for building and operating the ingestion and curation layers of Bridgestone's multi\-cloud Enterprise Data Platform. The EDP is a platform\-as\-a\-service: business units build their own data products on top of it, within guardrails and governance standards this role helps define and enforce. The platform runs on a Databricks and Unity Catalog backbone spanning AWS and Azure, delivering curated data to business units, BI and analytics teams, and conversational query experiences.
   

  

 This role writes code, designs pipelines, and sets the technical standard for a team of Data Engineers. This role partners closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineers, Product Owners, and business unit engineering teams. Deep Databricks expertise, strong data engineering fundamentals, and the ability to operate credibly in a large, matrixed enterprise are essential.
   

  

**Job Duties**
* Designs, builds, and operates industrialized data ingestion and transformation pipelines from source systems through the silver layer of a medallion architecture, using Databricks (Spark, Unity Catalog, workflows) as the core platform.
* Serves as the team's Databricks subject matter expert — data modeling in Delta, job and cluster design, performance and cost tuning, and Unity Catalog governance patterns.
* Guides, coaches, and technically mentors other Data Engineers; conducts design and code reviews to ensure architecture, platform, and solution standards are followed.
* Builds and maintains pipelines across multiple clouds — primarily AWS (Glue, Step Functions, Redshift, Aurora, Transfer Family, S3\) and Azure (Data Factory, ADLS) — and plans the migration of native cloud pipelines to Databricks as a destination technology.
* Defines and enforces the guardrails, standards, and reusable patterns that business units follow when building their own projects on the platform, balancing self\-service velocity against governance requirements.
* Partners with the BI and analytics teams to deliver curated, well\-modeled, well\-documented data products fit for reporting and for conversational query experiences such as Databricks Genie Space.
* Builds and maintains Databricks Genie Spaces over curated data, including the table selection, instructions, sample queries, and metric definitions that make natural\-language answers trustworthy. Reviews what Genie returns, and when an answer is wrong, fixes the underlying data model rather than patching the question.
* Sets the team's working practice for AI\-assisted engineering. Decides where AI tooling belongs in pipeline development, code review, testing, and documentation, where it does not, and what review is required before AI\-assisted work reaches production.
* Drives data quality, lineage, observability, and access control practices in partnership with data governance and security teams.
* Participates in early design reviews and architectural strategy for data modeling, design, and implementation within the responsible data domains.
* Drives continuous improvement and automation — CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, and operational tooling — and solicits recommendations from the team to ensure the right solutions are implemented at the right time.
* Monitors production pipelines, leads triage and root cause analysis for data incidents, and documents RCAs and SOPs to standardize and stabilize daily operations.
* Coordinates with vendors and platform partners (Databricks, AWS, Microsoft) to resolve product defects and escalations.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 8 years in data engineering or IT development, including 5 years of cloud data engineering and 3 years leading or technically guiding other engineers.
* Deep, hands\-on Databricks experience — Spark (PySpark/SQL), Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks workflows, and job/cluster performance and cost optimization. This is the core technology of the platform.
* Hands\-on working experience with Databricks Genie, including building Genie Spaces from scratch: curating the underlying tables, writing space instructions and sample queries, defining metrics, and tuning a space until its answers hold up under real business questions.
* Strong data engineering fundamentals: data modeling, dimensional and medallion architecture patterns, partitioning, incremental and CDC ingestion, idempotency, schema evolution, and backfill strategy.
* Demonstrated hands\-on pipeline development at enterprise scale — not solely oversight or coordination. This role builds.
* Production experience across multiple clouds, primarily AWS and Azure, including managed data services, storage, networking basics, and identity and access management.
* Expert\-level Python and SQL.
* Experience with orchestration at scale (Databricks Workflows, Step Functions, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent) for complex, dependency\-heavy pipelines.
* Working knowledge of data governance concepts, tools, and processes in a complex organizational environment — cataloging, lineage, data quality, and fine\-grained access control.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or equivalent) to promote code and release packages through environments.
* Experience working in large enterprise environments: matrixed teams, multiple business units with differing data maturity, change management, and formal release processes.
* Ability to perform end\-to\-end testing and debug issues across distributed cloud services.
* Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical constraints and trade\-offs to engineers, business stakeholders, and leadership.
* Practical experience with Agile delivery practices.
* Uses AI tooling as part of a normal working day rather than as an occasional experiment. Candidates will be asked to walk through their own workflow in the interview: which tools, at what points in the work, what they verify before trusting the output, and what actually got faster as a result.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Databricks certification (Data Engineer Professional or equivalent) or major cloud certification.
* Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and Terraform for platform infrastructure, identity, and compute policies.
* Experience preparing data assets for conversational or natural\-language query (Databricks Genie Space, semantic layers, metric definitions).
* Experience building platform capabilities consumed by other engineering teams — reusable frameworks, templates, or self\-service tooling.
* Working knowledge of ingestion from ERP and legacy sources (SAP CPI/SLT/PO, SAP BW, Teradata) into cloud or on\-premises databases.
* Exposure to AWS Redshift, Aurora, Glue, Athena, Kinesis, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, and Azure Synapse.
* Experience partnering with BI teams on semantic modeling and reporting enablement.


**Working Hours**
* Aligned to Bridgestone Nashville Head Office business hours, with overlap at least until 12PM Central Time Zone.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
At Zeta Global, we are building the next generation of AI\-powered marketing ecosystems. The “Prospect Audiences” team within the data layer powers ingestion of behavioral, demographic \& geographic identity signals and enables generation of smart audiences from the Zeta Data Cloud. These audiences are the cornerstone for improved audience targeting by Zeta’s customers and higher marketing ROI.
 



 As Director, Engineering, your immediate responsibility will be to own the Third\-Party Audiences product from an engineering, architecture \& technology purview, guide the team to deliver on immediate roadmap work items and work with product and business stakeholders to shape the product itself. Over time, the role could evolve into broader participation in the complete data layer (consisting of 6 other teams) and additional ownership.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the Prospect Audiences team, consisting of \~10 engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.
* Guide the team to deliver roadmap work items on time, of high quality, within the boundaries of the organization processes and guidelines.
* Collaborate with product and business teams to shape the future and long\-range roadmap for the team
* Collaborate with DevEx \& AI Enablement teams to drive adoption of AI\-native SDLC in the agentic software development paradigm, as applicable to the technologies used by the team.
* Partner with architects to build a world\-class data ingestion and processing architecture \& be at the forefront of technological innovation and continue to challenge yourself to deliver better outcomes for the customers.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop top talent within your team and the data layer in general.
* Own the system end to end, including production deployments, monitoring, distributed tracing, defining SLOs and thresholds for alerting, and managing on\-call support for production incidents.
* Monitor cost profile of the owned systems, participate in cost optimization initiatives, and execute cost optimization projects to keep the overall cost footprint as lean as possible.
* Own how the team ensures reliable, testable pipelines and datasets \- quality checks, lineage/observability of critical tables, and clear contracts/SLAs (or handshakes) between data producers and downstream consumers (including when things break).



**Qualifications:** 



* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time leading large\-scale data systems and teams.
* Deep domain expertise in batch \& real\-time data processing systems.
* Understand applicability, pros \& cons \& effectiveness of data engineering design patterns \& concepts such as Data Lakehouse, Data Table Format, Zero\-Copy Data Sharing, Cleanroom, Real\-Time vs Batch Data Processing, High throughput distributed system APIs
* Possess experience working on data technologies equivalent to:
+ Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
+ Iceberg, Hudi, Delta
+ EMR, Airflow, Spark
+ Aerospike, Scylla, DynamoDB

* Strong understanding of cloud data architectures (AWS, Snowflake, etc.).
* Track record of innovation and driving measurable outcomes, including AI\-driven or data\-driven product capabilities.
* Exceptional communication skills

Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here:  https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a\-look\-into\-zetas\-ergs/

The role is responsible for ensuring business continuity, platform governance, service stability, and user productivity across SharePoint Online and Power Platform solutions used by distributed project teams, corporate functions, and site operations.


The position requires strong technical troubleshooting capabilities, an understanding of Microsoft 365 governance, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, platform SMEs, Microsoft Support, and global delivery teams.

* Develop or support approved **Microsoft Copilot and agent\-based solutions** for ITSM use cases.

	+ Root cause analysis, trend identification, recurring issue elimination, and service improvement initiatives
	+ Enterprise CAB (Americas, EMEA, APAC), ICW calendar coordination, eCAB facilitation, and moratorium governance
	+ Service level monitoring, SLA reporting, stakeholder alignment, and continual service improvement
	+ ServiceNow release testing, Platform Analytics migration initiatives, and tool governance activities
	+ IT controls, compliance, audit readiness, and process documentation
	+ Development and support of Agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, Sidekick, and automation solutions that improve ITSM processes, reporting, knowledge management, and operational efficiency

* Five or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering or a related technology area.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Power BI**, including data modelling, dashboard development and report maintenance.
* Working proficiency in **Python and SQL** for analytics, automation and data processing.
* Experience working with **Snowflake, Data Lake or comparable cloud data platforms**.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data, validate results and communicate actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer\-service, teamwork and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently while working effectively in a global, collaborative environment.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Data Engineer to build and maintain X\-Rite Pantone's data infrastructure, enabling data\-driven decision making across our Software Engineering and Product organizations.


The role focuses on collecting, integrating, transforming, and exposing data from software development processes, digital products, cloud services, and connected measurement devices. This includes engineering metrics, product usage analytics, application telemetry, quality metrics, release information, customer workflows, and measurement data.


The successful candidate will work closely with software engineers, product managers, quality assurance engineers, application support teams, and data consumers across the organization to create scalable data platforms, reliable pipelines, and actionable insights.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data lake architectures.
* Integrate data from software development tools, including source control systems, issue trackers, test systems, CI/CD pipelines, and release management platforms.
* Collect, process, and model telemetry, analytics, and measurement data generated by X\-Rite Pantone software products and connected devices.
* Design and maintain data models that enable product analytics, engineering insights, and business reporting.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions for engineering, product management, and leadership teams.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability, and traceability across all data sources.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices for data platforms and pipelines.
* Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, QA engineers, and data scientists to define and prioritize data requirements.
* Provide clean, well\-documented, and consumable datasets for analytics, machine learning, and reporting use cases.
* Support data governance, security, and privacy requirements.
* Continuously improve data platform scalability, performance, automation, and developer experience.

**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**

* Strong experience building and operating data pipelines and data processing systems.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one modern programming language such as Python, C\#, or Javascript/Typescript.
* Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data warehousing concepts.
* Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, log streams, and cloud services.
* Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms and storage technologies.
* Ability to analyze stakeholder requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions.
* Understanding of software development processes, including source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, testing, and release management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global cross\-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS data services, esp. Redshift and Glue
* Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
* Experience working with software engineering metrics, DevOps analytics, or engineering effectiveness initiatives.
* Experience processing telemetry, IoT, or device\-generated data.
* Experience supporting machine learning or data science workflows.
* Familiarity with software development tools such as GitHub, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Experience working with DBT
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or a related technical role.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong ownership mindset and accountability for outcomes.
* Data\-driven approach to problem solving and decision making.
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional global environment.
* High learning agility and passion for continuous improvement.
* Ability to balance short\-term delivery with long\-term platform sustainability.
* Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India US/EU).


We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.


X\-Rite is proud to part of the Product Quality \& Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 16,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment *where purpose meets possibility*: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we’re Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™—and building rewarding careers along the way.


At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

title: Support and Operations Associate
description:
**Role Overview**  

Support and Operations Associate is an entry\-to\-early\-career role focused on delivering day\-to\-day customer support and operational execution under the guidance of senior team members. This role is ideal for someone building a foundation in fintech payments support, with clear pathways to grow into a Senior Support Engineer role as troubleshooting skills, ownership, and process knowledge develop.  

  

**Customer Support \& Query Resolution**

  

* Handle day\-to\-day customer support tickets and chats within defined SLAs, escalating complex or high\-impact issues to senior team members.
* Investigate and troubleshoot routine customer queries with guidance, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Support merchant onboarding activities by assisting with basic testing, documentation, and coordination tasks.
* Assist customers with product walkthroughs and first\-level operational guidance.


Service Quality \& SLA Adherence

  

* Adhere to defined SLAs, response timelines, and support processes for all assigned tickets.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date ticket records, ensuring proper categorization and documentation.
* Flag recurring or unresolved issues to seniors for review and follow\-up.
* Contribute to improving CSAT by maintaining quality and consistency in customer communication.


Basic Technical Troubleshooting

  

* Perform first\-level investigation of payment, payout, and integration\-related queries, escalating unresolved or complex cases to Senior Support Engineers.
* Coordinate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Operations) as directed for issue follow\-up.
* Provide timely status updates on assigned tickets to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Assist in maintaining incident logs and basic documentation for ongoing issues.


Knowledge Base \& Process Support

  

* Follow established SOPs and troubleshooting guides for issue handling.
* Flag gaps or outdated information in SOPs and knowledge base articles to seniors.
* Support the team in testing and adopting new tools, dashboards, or process changes.


Learning \& Collaboration

  

* Actively build product, process, and troubleshooting knowledge through training and shadowing senior team members.
* Collaborate with peers to share learnings and support each other on ticket handling.
* Participate in team training sessions and apply feedback to improve performance.


Cross\-Functional Support

  

* Assist in coordinating with Product, Tech, and Operations teams on routine issue follow\-ups as guided by seniors.
* Communicate basic status updates on assigned tasks and tickets to relevant stakeholders.
* Support cross\-functional projects (migrations, process rollouts) with execution\-level tasks as assigned.


Reporting \& Tracking

  

* Maintain personal ticket trackers and update status regularly.
* Support seniors in compiling data for SLA adherence, backlog, and resolution timeline reports.
* Assist in preparing basic status updates for ongoing tickets and projects.


Qualifications \& Experience

* **1–3 years** of experience in customer support, operations, or a related field; fintech/payments exposure is a plus but not required.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference for candidates comfortable with numbers and process\-driven work.
* Comfortable working with support tools (e.g., Freshdesk) and basic spreadsheet tools (Excel/Google Sheets).


Skills \& Attributes

  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and comfort following structured processes and SOPs.
* Willingness to learn technical concepts related to payments, payouts, APIs, and reconciliation.
* Ability to work under time\-bound SLAs and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Team player with a proactive, coachable attitude.

**Our Commitment to Fairness**  

Finmo is an inclusive, people\-first workplace that values merit and performance. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and to fostering a work environment free from discrimination. We evaluate all candidates on the basis of merit, performance, and role fit without regard to age, race, gender, religion, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic unrelated to job performance. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are already authorised to work in Singapore.  

  

We provide a supportive environment where our people can grow, contribute meaningfully, and thrive. All hiring decisions are made in accordance with applicable employment and fair employment laws in the country of hire.  

  

**Note:** Submissions by recruitment agencies will not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  

  

Thank you for your interest in pursuing a career with Finmo!

title: Power BI SME
description:
Job Description
  
**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Data \& AI practice is looking for a Power BI Consultant who can take a reporting requirement from the first conversation with a business user through to a published, refreshing, secured dashboard in production. This is a hands\-on build role with real client exposure — you will gather requirements, design the data model, write the DAX, build the visuals and own the solution through go\-live.


We are looking for someone who thinks about the model before the chart. Strong DAX and a clean star schema are what make a dashboard fast, accurate and maintainable, and this role is weighted towards that discipline as much as towards visual design. Programming exposure — particularly Python for data analysis — is a welcome addition and will be supported and developed in the role, but strong Power BI craft is what matters most.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and clarify reporting requirements with business and IT stakeholders — understand the questions being asked, the decisions they support, the underlying data sources and the definitions behind each metric.
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data model, KPI and measure definitions, report structure, navigation, security model and refresh approach.
* Design and build robust Power BI data models — star schema design, fact and dimension tables, relationships and cardinality, date/calendar tables, hierarchies and role\-playing dimensions.
* Write and optimise DAX — measures, calculated columns and tables, time intelligence, variables, context transition, and performance tuning of slow measures.
* Build and maintain Power Query (M) transformations — source connections, cleansing, shaping, merges and appends, query folding awareness, parameters and incremental refresh setup.
* Develop KPI dashboards and analytical reports that are visually clear and decision\-oriented — appropriate visual selection , consistent formatting, drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips and accessible design.
* Implement row\-level security — role design, DAX filter expressions, static and dynamic RLS patterns — and validate it thoroughly before release.
* Configure and manage Power BI Service operations: workspaces, apps, dataset publishing, scheduled refresh, on\-premises data gateway configuration, refresh failure troubleshooting and access management.
* Profile, validate and reconcile data against source systems — using SQL, and Python where you have it — to investigate anomalies and support analysis that goes beyond the dashboard.
* Write and tune SQL against source systems and data warehouses to extract, validate and shape data for reporting.
* Test and validate reports — reconciliation against source, measure accuracy checks, performance testing on realistic data volumes, and UAT support with business users.
* Document solutions — data dictionaries, measure definitions, model documentation and handover material — and support end users through training and adoption.
* Follow deployment and governance practice: workspace lifecycle, deployment pipelines, version control, naming standards and dataset certification where applicable.
* Contribute to reusable practice assets — report templates, DAX pattern libraries, theme files and accelerators.

  
Qualification
  
**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and delivering Power BI solutions in a client or enterprise environment.
* Strong DAX skills — measures, time intelligence, filter and row context, CALCULATE patterns, and the ability to debug and optimise existing DAX.
* Strong Power Query / M skills for data transformation, including handling multiple and messy source systems.
* Solid data modelling capability — dimensional modelling, star schema design, relationship and granularity decisions, and understanding of why model design drives report performance.
* Proven experience designing and building KPI dashboards that business users actually use , with attention to layout, clarity and interaction design.
* Hands\-on implementation of row\-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by a user/security table.
* Practical experience with Power BI Service administration: workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh , data gateway setup and refresh troubleshooting.
* Experience across the full delivery cycle — requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, UAT and go\-live support — not only report building to a handed\-over spec.
* Good SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions and query optimisation basics.
* Ability to engage business stakeholders directly, ask clarifying questions and explain technical constraints in plain language.
* Attention to detail on data accuracy, with the habit of reconciling and validating numbers before they reach a user.
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Programming exposure and data analysis in Python — pandas and numpy for data manipulation, basic visualisation and readable analysis scripts. Good to have rather than essential; an interest in building this skill is valued.
* Microsoft certification PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer).
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, semantic models and Direct Lake.
* Experience with Azure data services — Azure SQL, Synapse, Data Factory or Databricks — feeding Power BI datasets.
* Familiarity with Power BI performance tooling: DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer and Best Practice Analyzer.
* Experience with paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder) or Power BI Embedded.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) for embedded and write\-back scenarios.
* Awareness of data governance and cataloguing — Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labels and dataset certification.
* Version control and CI/CD experience for Power BI (Git integration, deployment pipelines).
* Domain exposure in one or more of manufacturing, BFSI, consumer goods, energy or healthcare reporting.

title: Data Migration Manager
description:
External Job Ad:
**Data Migration Manager**
==========================

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**


Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client\-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.

**Job Summary**


As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager owns the team's delivery outcomes end to end — from understanding what each customer expects and why, to translating those expectations into the technical work the team needs to complete, to confirming the outcome meets the customer's requirements. The Manager oversees a team of Data Migration Engineers, coaching and guiding their day\-to\-day work, while personally attending customer meetings during US hours to represent Data Services, answer questions in real time, and build trust with the customer directly.


This role works closely with a US\-based Relationship Manager who coordinates with the India\-based teams across multiple workstreams. The Data Migration Manager partners with this Relationship Manager on project status, customer sentiment, risk escalation, and resourcing, ensuring the two roles present a unified, well\-coordinated front to the customer.


This role operates within a global, Follow the Sun delivery model. To attend customer meetings in US time and to keep migrations moving seamlessly across regions and time zones, this position requires willingness to work a night shift aligned with US business hours.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Migration Engineers, setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and supporting career growth
* Own team performance management, including workload planning, capacity and resourcing decisions, and day\-to\-day people management (attendance, conduct, goal\-setting, and performance reviews)
* Attend customer meetings during US business hours, serving as the primary point of contact for customers — especially US\-based clients — providing regular status updates and managing expectations
* Understand each assigned migration project end to end: what the customer expects, why they expect it, and what the team needs to do — technically and operationally — to meet those expectations, translating customer requirements into clear direction for the team
* Work closely with the US\-based Relationship Manager who liaises with the India teams across multiple engagements, aligning on project status, customer sentiment, risks, and priorities so both roles speak with one voice to the customer
* Oversee assigned migration projects at a program level, tracking timelines, dependencies, and deliverables, and stepping in to unblock the team or escalate issues before they impact the customer
* Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive, or at\-risk migrations, working cross\-functionally with Onboarding and Success Services, Development, Operations, Solution Services, and Support to resolve issues quickly
* Support and reinforce the global Follow the Sun delivery model, ensuring smooth handoffs, clear documentation, and continuity of work across regions and time zones, including during night shift hours
* Communicate project status, risks, and outcomes clearly to both technical team members and non\-technical stakeholders, including customer contacts, the Relationship Manager, and internal leadership
* Champion standardized, repeatable processes and best practices across the team; identify opportunities to improve migration quality, speed, and the overall customer experience
* Partner with leadership on staffing, training, and tooling needs as Data Services processes and platforms (including cloud\-based platforms such as BigQuery and emerging automation/AI\-assisted tooling) continue to evolve
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen Data Services delivery capabilities, tooling, and customer outcomes

**What You'll Need to Succeed**
-------------------------------

* Proven experience managing, leading, or mentoring a technical team, ideally within a services, IT, or software delivery environment
* Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with demonstrated ability to build rapport and manage expectations with clients, especially customers based in the United States
* Ability to understand a project end to end — grasping customer requirements and business context well enough to translate them into clear technical and operational direction for the team
* Working knowledge of data migration, ETL, or database concepts (for example, data extraction, transformation, data quality, and SQL fundamentals) sufficient to guide a technical team and speak credibly with customers
* Comfort working closely with a Relationship Manager or similar counterpart, coordinating on status, risk, and customer sentiment so the customer experiences one consistent point of view
* Willingness and ability to work a night shift schedule, including attending customer meetings in US time, to support the global Follow the Sun delivery model
* Strong people management skills, including experience with performance feedback, coaching, conflict resolution, and team motivation
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities while remaining calm, organized, and customer\-focused under pressure
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability, balanced with the ability to align the team to shared standards, processes, and delivery goals
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline

**Additionally, You May Have**
------------------------------

* Prior experience in a Data Migration, ETL, or data services delivery role before moving into management
* Experience managing distributed or global teams across multiple time zones
* Experience working alongside a client\-facing Relationship Manager, Account Manager, or similar role on shared accounts
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (such as Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery) or automation and AI\-assisted tooling used in migration delivery
* Experience using Jira, SharePoint, or similar tools to track team workload, manage projects, and report on delivery status
* Experience presenting to or managing relationships with enterprise or SaaS customers

We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.**We flex our time together**, collaborating remotely and in\-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them. **Learn more about the people behind our products at** –* LinkedIn Page Applied Systems India

**Must Have Skills**
* Strong database administration experience across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and cloud database platforms.
* Expertise in database backup, recovery, replication, clustering, high availability, retention management, and restoration processes.
* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or a related discipline.
* Desirable certifications include one or more of the following: Oracle DBA, Microsoft Azure Database Administrator, AWS Database Specialty, Azure Solutions Architect
* Experience in technology transformation, regulated environments, or large\-scale database resilience and recovery programs.


**Preferred Profile Attributes**
* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.

description:
**Role Overview**
**Job Description – NetSuite Technical Lead**
 The NetSuite Technical Lead will be responsible for the overall technical architecture, integrations, customizations, data conversion enablement, and technical delivery of a NetSuite implementation for acquired Life Sciences organizations.
   

  

 The role will provide technical leadership across integration, development, reporting, security, data migration support, and platform architecture while ensuring alignment with NetSuite best practices and Life Sciences compliance requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Architecture \& Solution Design**
* Define end\-to\-end NetSuite technical architecture.
* Establish technical standards, development guidelines, and governance processes.
* Review and approve technical solution designs.
* Ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability of the solution.


**Integrations**
* Lead design and implementation of integrations between NetSuite and external systems including:
+ CRM platforms
+ Manufacturing systems
+ Laboratory systems (LIMS)
+ Quality Management Systems (QMS)
+ WMS platforms
+ Banking systems
+ EDI providers
+ Reporting and BI platforms

* Define integration architecture and middleware strategy.


**Customization \& Development**
* Lead SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, and SuiteCloud development activities.
* Review technical specifications and development deliverables.
* Minimize unnecessary customizations and promote NetSuite best practices.
* Ensure development follows coding standards and quality guidelines.


**Data Migration Support**
* Support Data Migration Lead in defining migration architecture.
* Design data load automation and migration utilities.
* Assist in data validation and reconciliation activities.
* Optimize migration performance and technical execution.


**Security \& Compliance**
* Define security architecture and role\-based access controls.
* Establish segregation of duties (SoD) controls.
* Ensure compliance with Life Sciences regulatory expectations where applicable.
* Support audit and validation requirements.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Define reporting architecture.
* Support creation of:
+ Saved Searches
+ Dashboards
+ KPIs
+ Financial Reports
+ Operational Reports


**Testing \& Deployment**
* Lead technical testing strategy.
* Support SIT, UAT, performance testing, and deployment activities.
* Manage release management and environment strategy.
* Support cutover and hypercare.


**Technical Leadership**
* Mentor developers, integration specialists, and technical consultants.
* Coordinate offshore and onshore technical teams.
* Manage technical risks and issue resolution.
* Provide executive\-level technical status reporting.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* 10\+ years of ERP technical implementation experience.
* 5\+ years of NetSuite technical leadership experience.
* Multiple end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation projects.
* Strong experience leading distributed technical teams.


**Technical Expertise**
**NetSuite**
* SuiteScript 2\.x
* SuiteFlow
* SuiteAnalytics
* SuiteTalk
* SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF)
* CSV Imports
* Saved Searches
* Workflow Automation


**Integration Technologies**
* Boomi
* Celigo
* MuleSoft
* Dell Boomi
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* EDI Integrations


**Data \& Reporting**
* SQL
* Data Migration Tools
* Reporting \& Analytics Platforms
* Data Warehousing Concepts


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NetSuite Certified SuiteCloud Developer
* NetSuite ERP Consultant Certification
* Experience in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical industries
* Experience with GxP\-regulated environments

**Key Skills**
* Solution Architecture
* Integration Architecture
* NetSuite Development
* Technical Governance
* Security \& Compliance

* Same as essential functions

description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As Specialist of HPC Cloud Engineering, you will maintain and support HPC solutions in the cloud using IaC, CICD, job schedulers (both cloud and on\-premise), researcher pipelines, and cloud\-native services. Automate low\-value tasks to allow scientists to focus on high\-value work, leveraging elastic cloud resources to accelerate workflows. Optimize HPC resource availability, its performance and cloud costs. Collaborate with senior HPC SMEs, Application Support Engineers, and research stakeholders to reduce cycle times, boost efficiencies, and enhance UX, increasing researcher capacity.
  
Ultimately, you will play a key role in implementing scalable and efficient solutions on AWS to support compute\-intensive applications. We are looking for an individual with passion for HPC and motivated to provide worldclass HPC experience to enable research scientists to use the power of leading\-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
* Deploy, maintain and support high\-performance computing clusters, platforms and AWS managed services.
* Monitor and maintain the performance of HPC cluster resources in both on premises and AWS, ensuring high availability, reliability and user experience.
* Optimize compute and data workflows for performance and cost\-efficiency in cloud\-based HPC environments.
* Create scripts and tools for automating cluster deployment, monitoring, and management (e.g., using Terraform, Ansible, AWS CLI, etc.).
* Analyse and determine bottlenecks in HPC cloud environment, including network performance and parallel file systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues in complex HPC environments, including job scheduling, software, and cloud infrastructure.
* Document processes, configurations, and best practices for HPC workloads in AWS and Linux environments.
* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and Hyderabad based Director, as well as collaborating with other teams.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.


What should you have
  
* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3\-7 years of experience in HPC infrastructure engineering, working with network principles, and system administration for Linux/Unix servers.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
* Hands\-on proficiency in Linux operating systems, shell scripting, HPC architecture and job schedulers in a DevOps environment.
* Experience with job schedulers and orchestrators viz. GridEngine, PBS Pro, and Altair NavOps.
* Knowledge of network architectures and high\-speed interconnects.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to convey findings and recommendations.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential risks.
* Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accurate assessments and reporting.
* Understanding of relevant regulations and compliance standards.
* Experience with disaster recovery, data backup solutions, and virtualization platforms
* Good problem\-solving skills
* Customer product\-centric mindset
* Ability to work effectively in a matrixed and hybrid environment


Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
* Relevant certifications (ideally AWS)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (virtual networks, VPNs, firewalls) and storage technologies
* Formal training in HPC.
* Experience with SLURM and AWS ParallelCluster.
* Computational Chemistry, Computational Biology or Imaging Processing domain knowledge.
* Experience with Atlassian stack.

title: System Development Engineer II, Amazon WWR&R
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.  

  

WW RR\&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR\&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing groundbreaking products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon \- returns and recommerce.  

  

Amazon WW RR\&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  

  

Primary responsibilities of System Development Engineer include automation and tool development, troubleshooting and diagnosing systemic and infrastructure issues, fixing production software issues, developing monitoring solutions, performing software maintenance and configuration, implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, Ruby, Java), performing SQL queries, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems.  

  

The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.  

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  

  

Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. **Company Description**  
RAKwireless is a leading innovator in the Internet of Things (IoT) industry, dedicated to simplifying design complexities and accelerating time\-to\-market through its modular IoT solutions. Through its innovative hardware components and unified software ecosystem, RAKwireless aims to eliminate connectivity and interoperability barriers, empowering both emerging and established markets.

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a Embedded Systems Engineer to join our team to support customer deployments, proof\-of\-concept (POC) builds, and field testing for our modular IoT hardware ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with hardware built on the RAKwireless ecosystem (core microcontrollers, wireless modules, and sensor boards). Your main goal will be to own technical troubleshooting, build practical demonstrations, run field coverage tests, and create comprehensive technical documentation. Ultimately serving as a key technical resource and reducing routine operational dependencies on senior SMEs.

​**Requirements**

***Experience:***Min 1 year of on paper experience is required.

* Troubleshooting \& Support: Reproduce, analyze, and troubleshoot customer\-reported hardware, firmware, and integration issues in lab environments.

* Field Testing \& Deployment: Conduct on\-site and field tests to evaluate wireless coverage, range, power consumption, and reliability across various deployment scenarios (e.g., LoRaWAN, BLE, Cellular).
* Documentation \& Knowledge Base: Document engineering results, field test data, and integration steps as technical reference guides, application notes, and case studies.
* SME Offloading: Take ownership of standard hardware/firmware queries to streamline customer support and significantly reduce routine support burdens on core SMEs.

***Key Qualifications \& Requirements:***

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Telecommunication Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

* Firmware \& Software: Proficiency in C / C\+\+ (Arduino IDE, STM32CubeIDE, PlatformIO) and introductory scripting tools (e.g., Python) for testing and data logging.
* Technical Debugging: Experience with electronic debugging tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and board\-level troubleshooting.
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal technical communication skills to document case studies and interact clearly with both internal teams and external customers.
* Experience with network/protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark) or LoRaWAN Network Servers (ChirpStack, The Things Network).

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**The Opportunity**
 ACA believes that we can deliver the world’s best GRC software to our blue\-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver “The Salesforce of Compliance”. Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA’s ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800\+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients.
   

  

 The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation\-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo\-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
   

  

 We are looking for an imaginative self\-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow\-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands\-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills.
   

  

**What To Expect Day To Day**
 As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Connectors team, you’ll help ensure the reliability of data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of data from platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Bloomberg, and other enterprise systems.
   

  

 On a typical day, you will:
   

  

  

* Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team.
* Design, develop, and execute automated functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of our data pipelines.
* Collaborate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.
* Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform.
* Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies.
* Expand your Python expertise while working with modern data engineering technologies.
* Participate in manual validation and release testing during production release cycles when needed.


**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies.
* Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
* At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python.
* Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python\-based ETL processes.
* Experience consuming REST APIs using Python.
* Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code.
* Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests.


**Nice to have**
* Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines.
* Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience testing data\-intensive or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines.


**What We Look For**
 We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B\-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference.
   

  

**What Working At ACA Offers**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
   

  

**Plus, we offer:**
* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**Why join our team?**
 We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
   

  

 Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award\-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
   

  

**More About ACA**
 ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
   

  

 Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
   

  

**What We Commit To**
 ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
   

  

 ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
   

  

 Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering - Embedded Systems & PLC Controls
description:
**Job Title:**


Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering \- Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**Job Description:**

**Senior****Embedded****Software/Firmware Engineer – Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software/Firmware Engineer to develop, integrate, and support embedded software, firmware, and PLC\-based control systems for industrial and electromechanical products used in semiconductor manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have strong embedded C/C\+\+ development experience along with practical knowledge of real\-time control systems, industrial automation, and PLC integration.


This role will support product development and sustaining engineering from concept through commercialization. The engineer will collaborate with electrical, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to translate requirements into reliable designs; develop, test, debug, qualify, and document solutions; support hardware bring\-up and system integration; and resolve field and manufacturing issues through structured root\-cause analysis.


The primary focus is embedded firmware and system integration. PLC, HMI, and SCADA experience is important, but the successful candidate is not expected to be an expert in every platform or protocol listed below.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, test, and maintain** embedded firmware for microcontroller\- and processor\-based systems using C/C\+\+.
* **Develop low\-level drivers**, communication stacks, middleware, and application software for embedded products.
* **Implement and optimize** real\-time control functions, including task scheduling, interrupt handling, state machines, timing, fault handling, and diagnostics.
* **Integrate embedded controllers** with PLCs, sensors, actuators, motors, drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks.
* **Implement, integrate, and troubleshoot** CAN, RS\-232/422/485, UART, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, and TCP/IP communications.
* **Partner with electrical engineers** to bring up and validate new hardware platforms using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
* **Translate product** **needs** into functional and non\-functional software requirements, interface specifications, architecture, timing and memory constraints, and verification criteria.
* **Create and maintain technical documentation**, including requirements, architecture descriptions, interface documents, process flows, state\-machine diagrams, test plans, test reports, release notes, and troubleshooting guides.
* **Develop unit, integration, regression**, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system\-level tests; create tools and scripts that improve automation, repeatability, diagnostic coverage, and data analysis.
* **Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews**; apply coding standards, version control, issue tracking, configuration management, and secure development practices.
* **Support stage\-gate and New Product Introduction** activities from concept and prototype through design verification, validation, qualification, release, and transfer to manufacturing.
* **Support sustaining engineering** by troubleshooting software, firmware, hardware\-interface, manufacturing, and field issues; perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* **Collaborate with domestic and international engineering teams**, product management, manufacturing, quality, customers, suppliers, and external development partners.
* **Estimate effort**, identify technical and schedule risks, communicate tradeoffs, and take ownership of assigned work through completion.
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience developing embedded software or firmware.
* Strong programming skills in C and C\+\+ for embedded systems.
* Hands\-on experience with RTOS concepts, embedded hardware architecture, interrupts, concurrency, timing, memory, and real\-time constraints.
* Experience developing low\-level drivers and integrating peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, and RS\-485\.
* Experience developing or integrating at least one industrial communication protocol or control network.
* Experience with Git or similar version\-control systems, code review, defect tracking, and controlled software release practices.
* Experience qualifying and validating software against written specifications through unit, integration, and system\-level testing.
* Ability to read schematics and troubleshoot embedded hardware and firmware interfaces using standard laboratory and debug equipment.
* Ability to create clear requirements, design documents, interface specifications, test plans, test reports, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple assignments, and deliver in a fast\-paced product\-development and sustaining environment.
**Nice to Have**

*Candidates are not expected to have every item listed below. These capabilities are considered nice to have and may broaden the candidate’s fit based on the products and technologies supported by the team.*

* Experience programming or integrating industrial PLC platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* Experience developing or maintaining HMI and SCADA applications.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as CANopen, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, or OPC UA.
* Embedded Linux experience, including Yocto, Buildroot, board\-support packages, device drivers, or system services.
* **Develop and maintain PLC software** using one or more major platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* **Create, integrate, and support** HMI and SCADA interfaces for industrial equipment and engineering test systems.
* Working knowledge of PLC programming or PLC\-to\-embedded\-system integrati
* Motor\-control experience involving stepper, BLDC, or servo drives, encoder feedback, PID tuning, or motion profiles.
* Digital signal\-processing experience, including filtering, sampling, high\-resolution ADCs, or sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with semiconductor\-equipment communication standards such as SECS/GEM or HSMS.
* Experience with Python, C\#, automated test frameworks, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, containers, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing.
* FPGA/CPLD development or HDL familiarity.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity frameworks such as SEMI E187/E188 or IEC 62443\.
* Experience supporting semiconductor equipment or other regulated, high\-reliability industrial products.
* Experience with stage\-gate development and New Product Introduction.
* Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or computer\-science discipline.
