 43812
   

  

**About The Role.**
 We are seeking an experienced Associate Director, Application Engineering (MES) to provide technical leadership for McCain’s Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) strategy and implementation. This role will be instrumental in building and scaling a new MES capability, with a primary focus on the deployment, optimization, and long\-term sustainability of the Parsec TrakSYS platform across manufacturing operations.
   

  

 As a senior technology leader, you will guide solution architecture, technical standards, integration strategies, and application engineering practices while partnering closely with manufacturing, operations, and enterprise technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable MES solutions that drive operational excellence.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing.**
* Provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
* Serve as a subject matter expert for the Parsec TrakSYS platform, including configuration, customization, extension development, and platform administration.
* Define and evaluate MES architecture, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with long\-term business objectives.
* Review technical designs, custom development efforts, and coding standards to ensure quality, performance, and supportability.
* Lead the integration of MES solutions with ERP, automation, historian, quality management, and other enterprise systems.
* Partner with manufacturing stakeholders to understand operational requirements and translate them into effective technology solutions.
* Drive application engineering best practices, technical governance, and system lifecycle management.
* Analyze complex and highly customized MES environments, identifying opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve sustainability.
* Mentor engineers and technical team members, fostering knowledge sharing and capability development across the organization.
* Support strategic planning and roadmap development for McCain’s MES ecosystem and digital manufacturing initiatives.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of experience in MES, manufacturing applications, manufacturing IT, or related industrial technology environments.
* Deep hands\-on expertise with Parsec TrakSYS, including implementation, configuration, customization, extension development, and production support.
* Minimum 2\-3 years of direct experience working with Parsec TrakSYS or comparable enterprise MES platforms.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production systems within industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and providing architecture oversight for complex enterprise solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, optimization, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience integrating MES platforms with ERP, automation systems, historians, quality systems, and other operational technologies.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, technical design reviews, coding standards, and application lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to assess complex, customized solutions and recommend improvements for scalability, maintainability, and long\-term sustainability.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience mentoring technical teams and building organizational capabilities through coaching and knowledge transfer.


**About The Team.**
 The Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) team is a newly established capability within McCain focused on advancing our digital manufacturing strategy. This role will play a foundational part in shaping the technical direction, standards, and implementation approach for MES solutions across manufacturing operations. Working closely with application engineering, manufacturing, operations, and business stakeholders, the Associate Director will help build a high\-performing team and establish best\-in\-class MES practices centered around the Parsec TrakSYS platform.

description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


This is a hands\-on senior technology leadership role supporting the development and implementation of advanced analytics across Investment technology stacks, engaging directly with global stakeholders across Investments, Trading, Investment Operations, Products, Vendors, and wider technology teams. The role requires strong hands\-on engineering craft in Java and Python, alongside strategic leadership.  

This includes leveraging Generative AI, Big Data, Machine Learning, and other cutting\-edge Distributed Technology Stack with Full\-stack Development practices. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership with practical AI fluency — a clear, evidence\-based view of what works, what doesn't, and how to apply it. Applies solid financial industry business knowledge to support decision and strategy solutions in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Mentor the team members and lay out their collective path for growth.**Job Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Technology Leadership:** Define and drive technology strategy aligned with Investments business goals. Identify opportunities for value creation through cloud\-native architecture, data enablement, and full\-stack engineering solutions.
* **Hands\-On Engineering Leadership:** Remain hands\-on in Java and Python. Set the engineering bar across code quality, architecture, resilience, and cost efficiency. Contribute directly to design and implementation of critical components alongside leading the team.
* **Cloud \& Data Enablement:** Lead initiatives that leverage AWS services (e.g., S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, ECS) to build scalable, secure, and cost\-effective platforms for investment analytics, reporting, and modeling.
* **Practical AI Fluency \& Application:** Bring a pragmatic, evidence\-based view on AI/GenAI adoption. Identify, prototype, and productionise GenAI use cases in investment workflows, with a clear approach to guardrails, evaluation, cost, and latency trade\-offs.
* **Domain\-Driven Engineering:** Translate complex investment domain problems into actionable engineering solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to define problem statements and deliver high\-impact technology outcomes.
* **Solution Architecture \& Modeling:** Oversee the design and implementation of decision logic systems that support investment decision\-making and portfolio management.

description:
**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an experienced GIS Consultant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting the US Earth \& Environment (E\&E) Business Line. The GIS consultant will provide advanced expertise in geospatial analyses, environmental data management, and cartographic support for projects related to site investigation and remediation, power generation and distribution, environmental impact assessments, environmental planning and permitting, and other similar areas.
   

  

 The team you will join offers an exciting diversity of projects and clients. You will lead delivery and ensure technical excellence across all phases of the project. The role will be based in either Bengaluru or Noida.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Effectively execute GIS workflows for power \& energy and environmental projects, from data acquisition, digitizing, processing, analyses, QA/QC and final cartographic delivery, with minimal supervision
* Design, manage, and maintain scalable project geodatabases, including schema development, metadata standards, and long\-term data stewardship.
* Produce defensible GIS analyses and presentation\-quality cartographic products (maps, drawings, figures, charts, posters, etc.) for diverse audience including clients, regulators, engineers, and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Conduct constraint, sensitivity, and impact analyses for routing and siting studies, translating complex environmental data into decision ready outputs.
* Lead development of map design, scale, symbology, and data limitations to prevent misinterpretation or misuse of GIS outputs.
* Implement mobile GIS and field data collection workflows, including data validation, post\-processing, and enterprise integration.
* Configure and maintain ESRI web mapping environments (e.g., ArcGIS Online and/or enterprise portal) to support project teams, including publishing layers, organizing web maps, and controlling permissions/roles.
* Maintain high standards of data quality management, including QA/QC procedures, error detection, and documentation of assumptions and limitations.
* Manage multiple concurrent assignments while meeting consulting budgets, schedules, and quality expectations.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Geoinformatics, Geology, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in delivering GIS products for environmental consulting projects, especially in power \& energy sector.
* Demonstrated proficiency with ESRI technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and ArcGIS Server.
* Strong understanding of geodatabase design and management, including domains, subtypes, and feature class operations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and attention to detail, with an emphasis on professional map and visualization standards.
* Commitment to ethical data use, safety standards, and professional conduct, aligned with WSP policies.

* Experience designing and supporting mobile data collection solutions using ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123, including supporting field tools, user access management and organizational GIS portals.

The Global Technical Support Engineer serves as the highest level of technical escalation for endpoint computing services, providing advanced support for desktops, laptops, operating systems, applications, conference room technologies, and enterprise endpoint management. The role is responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex hardware, software, operating system, and infrastructure\-related issues while ensuring optimal endpoint performance, security compliance, and business continuity.


The engineer collaborates with Infrastructure, Security, Network, and Application teams, manages enterprise endpoint platforms, supports executive users, drives process improvements, and ensures timely resolution of incidents within agreed SLAs. This role also provides technical leadership and mentoring to L1/L2 support engineers while delivering an exceptional end\-user experience.

**What you'll do:**

* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex endpoint, operating system, application, and hardware\-related incidents.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve advanced desktop, laptop, peripheral, and operating system issues.
* Manage SCCM/MECM software deployments, operating system imaging, application packaging, and endpoint compliance.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring technical issues.
* Coordinate hardware diagnostics, warranty support, and replacement activities with OEM vendors.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, collaboration tools, and enterprise endpoint technologies.
* Manage and support conference room Audio/Video systems and executive meeting environments.
* Provide L2 network support and troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VLANs, and network connectivity.
* Maintain IT asset inventory and perform asset lifecycle management activities.
* Create reports, dashboards, and inventory queries using Inventory tools ServiceNow inventory and Manage Engine.
* Ensure incidents and service requests are resolved within agreed SLAs while providing timely communication to end users.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Security, and Application teams to resolve cross\-functional issues.
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and drive them to closure.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
* Mentor L1/L2 support engineers by providing technical guidance and knowledge sharing.
* Participate in endpoint security initiatives, vulnerability remediation, compliance activities, and process improvements.
* Provide support after\-hours support during critical incidents or business requirements.

**Our Technical Environment:**

* Windows 10/11, macOS
* SCCM/MECM, MDT, WDS
* Microsoft Intune \& Autopilot
* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office)
* Active Directory, GPO, DNS \& DHCP
* LAN/WAN, VPN \& Wi\-Fi Networking
* Teams Rooms \& AV Conferencing
* IT Asset Management \& Lansweeper
* Data Center Infrastructure (MDF/IDF)
* PowerShell \& Automation Tools

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 6 to 9 years of experience in End User Computing (EUC), Desktop Engineering, or Technical Support.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise endpoint environments in a global organization.
* Strong knowledge in Windows administration, SCCM/MECM, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting macOS devices and enterprise mobility solutions is preferred.
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals and enterprise IT infrastructure.
* Experience in IT asset management and hardware lifecycle management.
* Strong customer service, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Zeno** 




 An unprecedented energy transition has begun. To meet 2040 net zero goals, over 2 billion electric two\-wheelers (motorcycles) must be sold and $11 trillion in fuel consumption replaced. Zeno is building a tech platform to electrify this two\-wheeler market, currently responsible for more than 4% of the world’s GHG emissions. Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition and democratize the benefits across Africa, India, and Latin America. With a focus on East Africa as a starting point, Zeno is building a new energy ecosystem with ground\-up development of a fundamentally better electric motorcycle and associated battery swap network to drive a better experience for our customers.
 



 We are looking for audacious, creative, and committed people to join us on this important mission. You will be joining a bold team consisting of leading engineers, operators, and entrepreneurs hailing from companies that include Tesla, Apple, Google, SRAM, Ola Electric, Dott, LiveWire, Lucid, Bolt, Microsoft, SafeBoda, Sun Mobility, among many others. Zeno has just closed its seed round with Lowercarbon, Silicon Valley’s leading climate tech venture fund, Toyota Ventures, the VC of the world’s largest automotive company, and 4DX Ventures, a leading early\-stage investor in Africa.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Zeno is seeking a highly skilled and hands\-on
 **Data Engineer** 
 to design, build, and scale our global data ecosystem. Sitting within our core
 **Global Insights Node** 
 , this role is not a traditional corporate dashboard\-building job. You will bridge the gap between heavy hardware telematics and high\-fidelity operational intelligence.
 



 You will design and build a resilient, local\-first data architecture capable of handling high\-frequency telemetry from moving vehicles and distributed battery swap stations operating in environments with variable network connectivity.
 



 The ideal candidate combines strong systems engineering fundamentals with an analytical mindset, a passion for first\-principles problem solving, and a refusal to rely on bloated enterprise templates when a leaner, more elegant solution exists.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




**1\. Data Architecture \& Edge Ecosystem Design** 



* Design, build, and maintain a highly resilient, scalable data architecture capable of syncing, storing, and processing massive datasets from both centralized cloud services and distributed edge devices (battery swap stations and vehicles).
* Establish robust strategies for partition tolerance and local\-first data caching to handle intermittent cellular connectivity in emerging markets.



**2\. High\-Performance Pipeline Development** 



* Develop, test, and optimize batch and stream\-processing pipelines to handle real\-time IoT telematics, state\-of\-charge tracking, and transactional business data.
* Build efficient ingestion mechanisms from internal systems, IoT hardware modules, APIs, and third\-party operational platforms using languages like Go, Rust, or Python.



**3\. First\-Principles Infrastructure Optimization** 



* Constantly challenge the data\-stack status quo. Focus on building lightweight, cost\-effective, and highly performant data systems, selecting tools based on architectural suitability rather than industry hype.
* Optimize data storage layouts, partitioning schemes, and query mechanics to handle high data volumes with minimal latency and infrastructure cost.



**4\. Unified Semantics \& Intelligence Enablement** 



* Architect clean, well\-documented semantic layers and structured transformations (using SQL and modern modeling frameworks) to expose reliable datasets.
* Support both traditional analytical queries (BI dashboards in Grafana, Looker, or Kibana) and downstream machine learning and automated agentic pipelines.



**5\. Data Quality, Reliability \& Observability** 



* Implement strict data validation, monitoring, and proactive alerting frameworks to ensure absolute consistency and accuracy across the network.
* Define and maintain strict access control, governance, and data privacy standard practices across the global insights platform.



**6\. Engineering Hygiene \& DevOps** 



* Packaged and deploy data services using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Maintain elegant CI/CD automation pipelines for data code deployments and infrastructure\-as\-code updates.
* Ensure impeccable Git/version control hygiene (clean commit histories, thorough documentation, and rigorous peer code reviews).



  





**What You Bring** 



* **The Mindset:** 
 A true first\-principles thinker. You are energized by physical constraints (like network drops or limited hardware memory) and prefer elegant, custom\-tailored solutions over bloated, off\-the\-shelf enterprise software.
* **Core Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong programming fundamentals in systems\-adjacent or highly performant languages (
 **Go, Rust, or Python** 
 ) alongside advanced mastery of
 **SQL** 
 .
* **IoT \& Telematics Experience:** 
 Proven experience dealing with high\-volume, time\-series, or streaming telematics/IoT data.
* **Distributed Systems Knowledge:** 
 Hands\-on experience with modern streaming and orchestration tools (such as Kafka, Redpanda, Airflow, Spark, or Beam) and an understanding of how to run them efficiently.
* **Modern Warehouse Proficiency:** 
 Practical experience leveraging cloud\-native data warehouses or lakehouses (such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Redshift) for high\-performance analytics.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Foundations:** 
 Solid working knowledge of cloud ecosystems (AWS and/or GCP) and experience deploying robust services via Docker and Kubernetes.
* **Data Advocacy:** 
 Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex data schemas, structural bottlenecks, and analytical tradeoffs to both hardware engineers and business operations teams.



  





**Benefits** 



* **Competitive Salary:** 
 Highly competitive base salary based on your experience and technical capabilities.
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage:** 
 Company\-sponsored healthcare plan for you and your dependents.
* **Incredible Mission \& Culture:** 
 Join a world\-class, globally distributed team of engineers, operators, and builders who are driving the inevitable, multi\-trillion\-dollar transition of two\-wheelers to electric.

title: Data Engineer - Senior 2
description:
### **Job Summary**



Leads projects for design, development and maintenance of a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with key business stakeholders, IT experts and subject\-matter experts to plan, design and deliver optimal analytics and data science solutions. Works on one or many product teams at a time.


### **Key Responsibilities**



Designs and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Designs and implements framework to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Designs, develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses innovative and modern tools, techniques and architectures to partially or completely automate the most\-common, repeatable and tedious data preparation and integration tasks in order to minimize manual and error\-prone processes and improve productivity. Assists with renovating the data management infrastructure to drive automation in data integration and management. Ensures the timeliness and success of critical analytics initiatives by using agile development technologies such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban Coaches and develops less experienced team members.


**Competencies:**



System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.



Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.



Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.



Data Extraction \- Performs data extract\-transform\-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.



Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.



Quality Assurance Metrics \- Applies the science of measurement to assess whether a solution meets its intended outcomes using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including the SDLC standards, tools, metrics and key performance indicators, to deliver a quality product.



Solution Documentation \- Documents information and solution based on knowledge gained as part of product development activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.



Solution Validation Testing \- Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.



Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.



Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.



Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.


**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**



College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.


### **Experience**



Intermediate experience in a relevant discipline area is required. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in data engineering are highly preferred and includes:


* Familiarity analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and/or data regulations
* Background in processing and managing large data sets
* Design and development for a Big Data platform using open source and third\-party tools
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map\-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
* SQL query language
* Clustered compute cloud\-based implementation experience
* Experience developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud\-based environment and other data extraction tools and methods from a variety of sources
* Experience in building analytical solutions


Intermediate experiences in the following are preferred:


* Experience with IoT technology
* Experience in Agile software development


Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role



1\) Design, build, and optimize reusable data pipelines, curated data assets, and domain\-aligned data products that support analytics, operational reporting, APIs, automation, and GenAI use cases across Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Product Lifecycle, and other Enterprise Products domains.



2\) Apply Data\-as\-a\-Product principles by developing scalable, governed, and discoverable data assets with appropriate metadata, lineage, quality controls, and documentation, enabling self\-service consumption and enterprise\-wide reuse.



3\) Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Solution Engineers, and business stakeholders to prepare and deliver AI\-ready datasets, semantic models, vectorized content, and trusted knowledge sources that support GenAI, advanced analytics, and intelligent business solutions.



Required Skills, Education, or Experience



1\) Strong hands\-on experience developing and supporting enterprise data pipelines, data transformations, and data integration solutions using modern cloud data platforms, data warehouses, and ETL/ELT technologies.



2\) Experience with data modeling, SQL development, data quality validation, performance optimization, and scalable data architecture supporting multiple consumer patterns including reporting, APIs, analytics, and AI/ML.



3\) Ability to translate business and product requirements into reusable technical solutions while balancing data quality, performance, maintainability, and long\-term scalability.



4\) Experience working within cross\-functional Agile teams and collaborating effectively with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Architects, and business stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.



5\) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or equivalent practical experience.



Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills, Education, or Experience



1\) Experience working within a Data\-as\-a\-Product operating model, including data cataloging, lineage, metadata management, data product certification, and governance practices.



2\) Exposure to GenAI, AI/ML, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, knowledge management, or AI\-ready data engineering practices supporting enterprise AI solutions.

title: Data Engineer – SAS ETL, Oracle Database, SQL & Control-M
description:
****Job Summary****
 Synechron is seeking a
 **Data Engineer – SAS ETL – LPA** 
 with
 **4–6 years of relevant experience** 
 in SAS ETL and Oracle Database development. The role will focus on designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise\-scale data integration and ETL solutions. The successful candidate will use SAS, Oracle Database, SQL, and Control\-M to deliver reliable data processes, support data quality, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to analytics and data delivery objectives.
   

  

****Required****
**Software Requirements**
* SAS ETL: Hands\-on experience developing, enhancing, maintaining, and supporting ETL processes using SAS.
* Oracle Database: Mandatory hands\-on experience with Oracle Database, including queries, stored procedures, data models, data validation, and performance tuning.
* SQL: Strong experience writing and optimizing SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Control\-M: Experience scheduling, monitoring, managing, and troubleshooting ETL jobs.
* Data Warehousing Tools and Processes: Experience with data warehouse structures, ETL workflows, data integration, and data delivery practices.
* Development and Support Tools: Experience using tools for technical documentation, issue tracking, job monitoring, and production support.


****Preferred****
* Exposure to additional enterprise data integration, scheduling, or data quality tools.
* Experience supporting analytics\-focused data projects and large\-scale data processing environments.
* Familiarity with performance monitoring and optimization tools for SAS and Oracle environments.
* Exposure to automated testing, deployment, or release management tools used in data engineering delivery.


****Overall Responsibilities****
* Develop, enhance, maintain, and support ETL processes using SAS to meet approved business and technical requirements.
* Design, develop, and optimize Oracle Database queries, stored procedures, data models, and related data processing components.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable, maintainable, and technically accurate data integration solutions.
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and performance tuning across ETL and database processes.
* Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot ETL jobs using Control\-M to support reliable and timely data delivery.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data teams, application teams, testing teams, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve delivery issues.
* Apply data warehousing and ETL best practices to support data accuracy, completeness, consistency, maintainability, and operational stability.
* Investigate production issues, document findings, coordinate resolutions, and support post\-implementation validation.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, data mappings, process specifications, job schedules, support procedures, and operational records.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by reducing manual processing, improving job efficiency, reusing ETL components, and optimizing resource usage where applicable.
* Deliver reliable data integration solutions that support enterprise\-scale data delivery and analytics objectives.


****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****
* SAS programming for ETL development, data transformation, data validation, and processing.
* Strong SQL skills for complex queries, joins, subqueries, aggregations, stored procedures, reconciliation, and data analysis.
* Ability to interpret business rules and implement them through SAS ETL processes and Oracle Database components.


****Preferred****
* Exposure to scripting or programming languages used for job monitoring, automation, data validation, or operational support.
* Experience developing reusable utilities for ETL testing, reporting, or process monitoring.


**Databases and Data Management**
****Essential****
* Mandatory hands\-on experience with Oracle Database.
* Experience designing and optimizing Oracle queries, stored procedures, data models, and data processing logic.
* Understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL architecture, staging processes, data marts, and target data structures.
* Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, consistency checks, and data quality analysis.
* Ability to analyze data lineage, source\-to\-target mappings, transformation rules, and downstream data dependencies.
* Experience troubleshooting database and ETL performance issues.


****Preferred****
* Exposure to additional relational databases or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with data profiling, metadata, data governance, data quality controls, or data lineage tools.
* Experience supporting large\-volume data processing and analytics environments.


**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****
* Ability to support ETL and database processes in the environments used by the assigned project.
* Understanding of data integration, job scheduling, monitoring, and data delivery across enterprise environments.


****Preferred****
* Exposure to cloud\-based data platforms, databases, data warehouses, or ETL services.
* Experience supporting hybrid data environments or cloud migration initiatives.


**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****
* SAS ETL development and processing capabilities.
* Control\-M job scheduling and monitoring capabilities.
* Understanding of ETL design patterns, data transformation methods, error handling, restartability, dependency management, and batch processing.
* Ability to develop maintainable and reusable ETL workflows.


****Preferred****
* Exposure to data quality, testing, automation, or deployment frameworks used in enterprise data environments.
* Familiarity with reusable ETL frameworks, job control standards, or process automation utilities.


**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****
* 4–6 years of relevant experience in SAS ETL and Oracle development.
* Experience with requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Experience scheduling and monitoring ETL jobs through Control\-M.
* Understanding of structured software development life cycle and ETL delivery practices.
* Experience creating technical documentation, data mappings, job specifications, support procedures, and implementation records.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver accurate and timely data solutions.


****Preferred****
* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or comparable iterative delivery environments.
* Exposure to version control, release management, automated testing, continuous integration, or deployment practices.
* Experience participating in code reviews, technical walkthroughs, sprint planning, defect resolution, and continuous improvement activities.


**Security Protocols**
****Essential****
* Understanding of secure handling of enterprise data during ETL processing, database development, testing, and support.
* Ability to follow access\-control, data privacy, confidentiality, audit, and environment\-specific data handling requirements.
* Awareness of secure database access, credential management, logging, and controlled use of production and non\-production data.
* Ability to comply with Synechron’s applicable security, data governance, and operational standards.


****Preferred****
* Experience supporting data solutions in regulated or controlled environments.
* Exposure to data masking, encryption, role\-based access, audit logging, and security validation practices.


****Experience Requirements****
* 4–6 years of relevant professional experience in SAS ETL and Oracle Database development.
* Strong hands\-on experience developing, enhancing, maintaining, and supporting SAS ETL processes.
* Mandatory practical experience with Oracle Database, including SQL development, stored procedures, data models, validation, and performance tuning.
* Experience using Control\-M to schedule, monitor, troubleshoot, and manage ETL jobs.
* Experience with data warehousing, ETL best practices, data integration, data validation, and data quality activities.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical data solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting ETL and database issues and supporting reliable data delivery.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including business, development, testing, data, and support teams.
* Experience in enterprise\-scale data integration and analytics projects is preferred.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent professional experience in SAS development, ETL engineering, database development, or data integration roles where they can demonstrate comparable technical outcomes.


**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Develop and maintain SAS ETL workflows, write and optimize Oracle SQL and stored procedures, and validate data against source\-to\-target requirements.
* Schedule and monitor ETL jobs in Control\-M, investigate failures, perform troubleshooting, and coordinate resolution of data or processing issues.
* Participate in requirements discussions, technical reviews, testing activities, status meetings, and collaboration with cross\-functional delivery teams.
* Prepare technical documentation, data mappings, validation results, support records, and implementation deliverables while making technical decisions within approved standards.


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* 4–6 years of professional experience in SAS ETL and Oracle Database development, with demonstrated enterprise data integration experience.
* Relevant training in SAS ETL, Oracle Database, SQL, data warehousing, Control\-M, data quality, and production support practices is preferred.
* Certifications in SAS, Oracle Database, data engineering, data management, or related technologies are preferred but not required.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant technical training, product updates, data engineering practices, and evolving delivery standards.


**Professional Competencies**
* Apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving to analyze requirements, investigate data issues, troubleshoot ETL failures, and identify root causes.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, data teams, developers, testers, support teams, and other delivery participants.
* Communicate technical findings, data quality results, risks, dependencies, progress, and resolution plans clearly and accurately.

We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Senior Data Specialist (Lead Data Engineer)** 
 join our
 **Financial Systems Tech Support \-CAT IT Division**
 who can operate as a strong
 **hands\-on individual contributor** 
 while providing technical leadership and guidance across enterprise data initiatives. This role is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting scalable data solutions, analytics platforms, and automation capabilities that enable data\-driven decision making across the organisation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in
 **Data Engineering, Power BI, Microsoft Power Platform, Database Technologies, Cloud Platforms, System Design, and Modern Data Architectures** 
 . This individual should be capable of independently solving complex technical challenges, driving solution design, evaluating emerging technologies, mentoring team members, and ensuring the successful delivery of high\-quality data products.
   

  

 The role requires a balance of strong technical execution, architectural thinking, debugging expertise, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous innovation.
   

  

 The preference for this role is to be based out of
 **Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
**What You Will Do**
**Data Engineering \& Platform Development**
**Hands\-on Data Engineering**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable batch, near real\-time or streaming data pipelines.
* Build and optimise ETL/ELT solutions that process large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
* Develop reusable data integration frameworks, ingestion components, and orchestration workflows.
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade data warehouses, data lakes, and modern data platforms.
* Integrate data from databases, APIs, enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, files, and external systems.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and traceability across all data assets.
* Develop scalable data models that support reporting, analytics, operational workloads, and future AI/ML initiatives.


**Data Quality \& Governance**
* Implement data quality controls, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes.
* Establish monitoring, observability, lineage, metadata management, and auditing capabilities.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security, and retention requirements.
* Partner with governance and business teams to improve trust and usability of enterprise data.


**Visualization Solutions (Good to have)**
**Power BI Development**
* Design and develop enterprise\-grade dashboards, reports, scorecards, and executive visualisations using Power BI.
* Create intuitive, interactive, and business\-focused visualisations that provide meaningful insights.
* Develop and maintain semantic models, datasets, KPIs, metrics, and reporting frameworks.
* Design star schemas and dimensional models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
* Implement advanced DAX calculations, measures, and performance optimisation techniques.


**Business Intelligence \& Reporting**
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into scalable BI solutions.
* Establish Power BI development standards, governance practices, and reporting best practices.
* Optimize report performance, data refresh processes, and dataset management.
* Implement Row\-Level Security (RLS) and data access controls where required.


**Power Platform \& Automation**
**Power Automate**
* Design and implement automated business processes using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Build workflows for approvals, notifications, data synchronisation, document processing, and operational automation.
* Integrate Power Automate with SharePoint, Power BI, Dataverse, Microsoft 365, APIs, and enterprise systems.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual business processes and improve operational efficiency.


**Power Platform**
* Contribute to the design and implementation of solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.
* Support integration between Power Apps, Power BI, data platforms, and backend systems.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with governance standards.


**Solution Design \& Architecture**
**Solution Ownership**
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end architectures for data ingestion, transformation, storage, reporting, and automation solutions.
* Develop high\-level and low\-level solution designs for complex technical initiatives.
* Evaluate architectural trade\-offs related to performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost.


**System Design**
* Design enterprise\-scale data platforms and distributed systems.
* Develop integration patterns for APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and cloud\-native solutions.
* Define non\-functional requirements including:
+ Scalability
+ Performance
+ Availability
+ Reliability
+ Security
+ Maintainability
+ Observability

* Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, and technical governance activities.


**Problem Solving \& Debugging Excellence**
**Complex Problem Resolution**
* Lead analysis and resolution of complex technical challenges across data platforms and applications.
* Apply strong analytical thinking and systems\-thinking approaches to troubleshoot issues.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into actionable technical solutions.


**Debugging \& Root Cause Analysis**
* Investigate and resolve issues across Data Pipelines, Power BI Reports, Dashboards, Database Platforms, Cloud Services, APIs and Integrations, and ETL/ELT Processes.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement long\-term corrective actions.
* Identify recurring issues and implement preventive engineering improvements.
* Develop monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies to proactively identify potential failures.


**Performance Optimisation**
* Optimise SQL queries, ETL workloads, Power BI datasets, data models, and reporting solutions.
* Improve scalability, throughput, and performance of enterprise data platforms.
* Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements.


**Cloud \& Modern Data Technologies**
**Cloud Platforms**
* Design and develop cloud\-based data solutions leveraging modern cloud technologies.
* Support cloud migration, modernisation, and optimisation initiatives.
* Implement secure and scalable cloud\-native data architectures.


**Preferred Cloud Knowledge**
* AWS or Azure
* Snowflake
* Databricks


**Responsibilities**
* Design highly available and fault\-tolerant solutions.
* Support infrastructure automation and cloud governance initiatives.
* Implement secure storage, processing, and access patterns.
* Optimise cloud cost, performance, and operational efficiency.


**Technology Exploration \& Innovation**
**Emerging Technologies**
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies, tools, frameworks, and industry trends.
* Research modern data engineering, analytics, automation, AI, and cloud platforms.
* Conduct Proof of Concepts to assess business value and technical feasibility.


**Innovation**
* Explore new tools, frameworks, and engineering practices that improve productivity and scalability.
* Identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and technical simplification.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering teams.


**Team Leadership \& Collaboration**
**Technical Leadership**
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Data Engineers.
* Support design discussions, code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and knowledge\-sharing activities.
* Promote engineering standards, best practices, and consistent delivery approaches.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with Product Owners, Architects, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, Infrastructure Teams, and Business Stakeholders.
* Help prioritise work, remove technical blockers, and support successful project execution.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.


**What You Will Have**
**Education and Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 10\-14 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong experience on advanced SQL any Database. (Oracle, Teradata, snowflake).
* Experience in data integration area and hands on experience in any of the ETL tools like Datastage , Informatica , Snaplogic etc.
* Able to transform technical requirements into data collection query.

* Good understanding of ETL architecture and design.
* Good knowledge in Databases, SQL, or PL/SQL
* Good experience with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions (AzDO pipelines)
* Good to have knowledge on Unix commands
* Good to have an experience on AWS Glue
* Good to have knowledge on Qlik replication tool
* This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week schedule in the office.
* Shift Timing: 01:00\-10:00PM IST


**Data Engineering**
* Advanced SQL and database development expertise.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Python for data engineering and automation.
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, data integration, and modern data engineering patterns.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake, Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or similar technologies.
* Experience with integration platforms such as AWS Glue, SnapLogic, Informatica, DataStage, or equivalent tools.


**Power Platform \& Analytics**
* Strong experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
* Expertise in Power BI DAX, data modelling, report optimisation, and visualisation design.
* Experience with Power Automate workflow development and process automation.
* Working knowledge of the broader Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem.


**Architecture \& Engineering**
* Experience designing enterprise data platforms and distributed systems.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of API integration, microservices, and modern system design principles.
* Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation practices.


**Cloud \& Infrastructure**
* Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of cloud\-native architecture patterns and modern data services.
* Understanding of security, governance, monitoring, and operational support best practices.


**Leadership \& Professional Competencies**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to independently lead technical initiatives with minimal supervision.
* Strong ownership mindset and accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and guide engineering teams.
* Effective mentoring, coaching, and knowledge\-sharing abilities.
* Passion for learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Success Measures**
* Delivery of reliable, scalable, and secure data solutions.
* High\-quality Power BI dashboards and business intelligence capabilities.
* Increased automation and operational efficiency through Power Automate and Power Platform solutions.
* Effective resolution of production issues through strong debugging and root cause analysis practices.
* Successful adoption of new tools and technologies that enhance engineering productivity.

* Consistent delivery of business value through robust data engineering and analytics solutions.


**What You Will Get**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

 Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business \- from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Data Engineer is a key role within the Customer Remediation team that focuses on delivering business outcomes to build reusable data solutions and assets that drive efficiency and productivity. These solutions will deliver speed and agility enabling data analysts to advance and accelerate the delivery of timely customer outcomes. Overallapproach is to simply, standardise and automate.
   

  

 A key focus of this role is partnering and collaborating with Business Analysts and Data Analysts to design and deliver technical solutions. The role is also responsible for maintaining existing data assets and solutions through effective debugging, root cause analysis, and resolution of production issues.
   

  

 This role requires a strong understanding of data engineering, data analysis, reporting, and data automation techniques and workflows. The ideal candidate is an experienced Data Engineer with a proven track record of developing data products that support analytical solutions. Advanced SAS programming expertise is essential.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Permanent
   

  

**Role Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Work Hours:** 
 Regular (Hybrid\\Blended)
   

  

**What will your day look like?**
 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be accountable for:
   

  

 Financial:
   

  

* Support the achievement of agreed financial targets
* Operate in a manner that is cost effective and efficient with all resources


 Customer:
   

  

* Contribute to design and implementation of technical solutions
* Develop, test and implement to meet technical / business requirements
* Provide full transparency of status throughout delivery


 Process:
   

  

* Encourage a culture of continuous improvement – simplify and improve processes where possible
* Ensure that quality control and data governance processes are followed
* Provide accurate estimates of the end\-to\-end resource required for developing or maintaining code


 People:
   

  

* Participate as a team member positively around team culture and growth
* Provide guidance and support to peers through code reviews, and technical leadership


 Risk/Compliance/Behaviours:
   

  

* Alignment and adherence with ANZ Group IT strategy, governance policies, processes and standards and with external regulatory requirements


**What will you bring?**
* Overall 4 to 6 years of work experience. Exposure to Python is highly beneficial.
* Experience in SAS, SQL coding (development and analysis skills)
* Able to demonstrate a high regard for urgency and deadlines. Must be detail orientated and be strongly driven by quality
* Problem\-solving and analytical mind\-set, with a strong attention to detail
* Broad knowledge of Financial Service products and processes
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to collaborate with people at different levels
* Able to produce high quality, high output work
* Work with project stakeholders and developers, applying an understanding of organisational context to analyse and synthesise information, and to translate business requirements into technical requirements
* Solid understanding of data development lifecycles, disciplines and procedures.
* Can appreciate difficult problems and work autonomously on tasks with a medium complexity, can work collaboratively as part of a team and clearly articulate \& present consolidated findings.


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number
 **123780\.**

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Principal Data Engineer at Equinix, you will be responsible for driving end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise\-scale data solutions on Google Cloud Platform. This role combines hands\-on technical expertise, requiring you to design sophisticated system architectures, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and mentor data engineers. You will act as a trusted technical advisor for the team championing innovation across GCP, Data Engineering, AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled technical depth, exceptional strategic thinking, and a demonstrated history of delivering transformational data platform capabilities at a global scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 System Design \& Architecture Leadership
   

  

* Architect and evolve cloud\-native, petabyte\-scale data platforms and data products, with clearly defined and measurable SLOs for data freshness, availability, and reliability
* Design data solutions balancing scalability, performance, cost, and operational excellence through clear architectural trade\-offs
* Establish reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and engineering standards adopted organization\-wide
* Lead architectural governance across all data engineering squads, ensuring consistency, scalability, and security
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies (including Agentic AI/LLM and real\-time systems) to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes
* Drive adoption of domain\-oriented data architecture (e.g., data mesh principles) across business domains to enable ownership, consistency, and reuse


 Technical Solutioning \& Innovation
   

  

* Design scalable data solutions using modern cloud\-native technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, dbt/Dataform, Pub/Sub), selecting the right tools based on problem context
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex data engineering initiatives from design through production, and continuous evolution.
* for real\-time streaming, event\-driven architectures, and unified batch\-streaming pipelines at petabyte scale
* Evaluate and adopt AI/LLM capabilities to improve engineering productivity and enable intelligent data consumption, using standard interfaces (e.g., Model Context Protocol) to integrate AI with data systems
* Establish engineering excellence frameworks covering performance engineering, cost governance, reliability, and observability
* Lead proof\-of\-concept and rapid prototyping of breakthrough technologies before scaling org\-wide


 Team Leadership \& Mentorship
   

  

* Serve as a technical role model and multiplier — elevating the capabilities of Senior Staff, Staff, and Data Engineers across the organization
* Lead org\-wide engineering communities of practice and knowledge\-sharing initiatives
* Partner with engineering managers and HR to drive technical hiring strategy and raise the engineering talent bar
* Drive culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning
* Establish mentorship programs that systematically grow the next generation of technical leaders


 Data Governance \& Compliance
   

  

* Architect automated data quality platforms, end\-to\-end lineage tracking, and enterprise metadata management systems
* Ensure compliance with GDPR, SOX, and emerging global data regulations through proactive architecture and policy design
* Lead privacy\-by\-design initiatives, zero\-trust data access models, and data anonymization at scale
* Establish cross\-cloud security standards and enforce them through automated policy guardrails
* Design privacy\-preserving techniques, data anonymization, and secure data sharing mechanisms


 Strategic Influence \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and business units
* Present technical concepts and architectural decisions to executive leadership
* Represent Equinix externally — at industry conferences, in open\-source communities, and in strategic vendor partnerships
* Drive build\-vs\-buy decisions, vendor evaluation, and strategic technology partnerships at the enterprise level


**Qualifications**
 Technical Expertise
   

  

* GCP Platform Mastery: 8\+ years of hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, including deep expertise in BigQuery (advanced SQL, scripting, optimization, ML integration), Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, and Vertex AI
* Programming Excellence: Expert\-level Python/Java programming, proficiency in Python/Scala for Spark development
* Advanced Data Technologies: Deep expertise in Apache Beam, Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, and distributed computing architectures
* Infrastructure: Extensive experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure management
* Database \& Data Modeling: Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL systems (BigTable, Firestore, MongoDB); expertise in data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization
* System Design: Proven ability to architect and deliver distributed, fault\-tolerant, globally distributed data systems with rigorous security and cost governance
* AI/ML Integration: Deep experience with MLOps, feature engineering platforms, model serving infrastructure, and integrating LLM\-powered capabilities into production data pipelines


 Professional Experience \& Leadership
   

  

* Master's or bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree strongly preferred
* 15\+ years of Data engineering experience with 8\+ years specifically on Google Cloud Platform
* Proven track record of leading end\-to\-end delivery of complex, enterprise\-scale data platform initiatives
* Experience designing and implementing data governance, compliance, and security frameworks
* Strong architectural thinking with ability to make sound technical decisions and trade\-offs
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and solutions
* Strong business acumen — ability to connect technical architecture decisions to measurable business outcomes
* Solve complex, ambiguous data platform challenges and drive decisions that improve system reliability, performance, and cost at scale


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer and Cloud Architect certifications
* Hands\-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks, LLM orchestration, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) in production environments
* Published thought leadership — technical blog posts, conference talks, or open\-source contributions in data engineering
* Experience with feature stores, model serving infrastructure, and AI/ML observability
* Understanding of data science workflows, statistical analysis, and advanced analytics
* Experience with BI and visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Contributions to industry standards bodies, open\-source foundations, or emerging technology working groups
* Experience with multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud architectures and data portability strategies
* Knowledge of data mesh, data fabric, or other modern data architecture patterns

title: ETL Developer
description:
**Description**
*Position at Optimas International*
 ETL Developer

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Work Policy: Hybrid
   

  

**About Optimas**
 Optimas is a global distributor of integrated supply chain solutions and engineering support services, specializing in fasteners, industrial components, safety products, and supply chain optimization. Operating across multiple regions, Optimas partners with leading manufacturing and distribution organizations to deliver reliable, efficient, and scalable business solutions. Our teams combine local expertise with global capabilities to support customers through innovative technology, data\-driven decision making, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 Optimas is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior ETL Developer with 4\+ years of expertise in Data Warehousing, Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, ETL, ERP Integrations, Data Replication, and Enterprise Data Management Solutions and Power BI(Nice to Have).
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have extensive hands\-on experience designing, developing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise\-scale ETL/ELT solutions, Data Warehouse platforms, and integration frameworks that consolidate data from ERP, CRM, Supply Chain, Distribution, Procurement, Finance, and Manufacturing systems into centralized reporting and analytics environments.
   

  

 This role will be instrumental in driving the modernization of Optimas' enterprise data ecosystem, supporting both on\-premises and cloud\-based data platforms while ensuring high standards of data quality, scalability, performance, security, governance, and business alignment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Data Warehouse \& Enterprise Data Integration
   

  

* Design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise Data Warehouse solutions supporting Sales, Finance, Procurement, Inventory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations reporting.
* Architect and implement scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple enterprise applications into centralized analytical platforms.
* Develop and maintain dimensional data models using Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and Data Vault concepts where appropriate.
* Design and implement Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, Aggregate Tables, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1, Type 2, and Hybrid approaches).
* Build reusable ETL frameworks, metadata\-driven processes, error handling mechanisms, audit logging, data reconciliation, and validation frameworks.
* Develop advanced T\-SQL solutions including complex stored procedures, views, functions, triggers, CTEs, window functions, and performance\-optimized queries.
* Perform source\-to\-target mapping, data profiling, data lineage analysis, and data transformation design.
* Implement enterprise data quality controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity across business systems.


 SSIS Development \& Data Migration
   

  

* Design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise\-grade SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) packages.
* Build SSIS solutions utilizing:
+ Control Flow and Data Flow Tasks
+ Package Configurations
+ Parameters and Expressions
+ Script Tasks and Script Components
+ Lookup Transformations
+ Merge and Merge Join Transformations
+ Derived Column Transformations
+ Conditional Split Transformations
+ Slowly Changing Dimension Transformations
+ CDC and Change Tracking Implementations
+ Error Handling and Logging Frameworks

* Develop high\-performance SSIS solutions for large\-volume data extraction, transformation, loading, and migration activities.
* Optimize package execution through parallel processing, partitioning, bulk loading, and performance tuning techniques.
* Support data migration and system modernization initiatives involving ERP, WMS, CRM, and legacy platform consolidations.
* Implement and manage incremental loading, near real\-time integration, and change data capture (CDC) solutions.


 Microsoft SQL Server \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Administer, maintain, and optimize Microsoft SQL Server environments across Development, QA, UAT, and Production.
* Support SQL Server databases, including performance monitoring, capacity planning, indexing strategies, and query optimization.
* Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high\-availability solutions.
* Implement and support:
+ SQL Server Replication (Transactional, Snapshot, and Merge Replication)
+ Always On Availability Groups
+ Database Mirroring
+ Log Shipping
+ High Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) Solutions

* Conduct database health checks and proactively identify performance bottlenecks.
* Support database security, permissions management, auditing, encryption, and compliance requirements.
* Analyze execution plans and optimize database objects to improve system performance.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure and Application teams on database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and release activities.


 ERP \& Enterprise Application Integration (Value Addition)
   

  

* Design and maintain integrations between Data Warehouse platforms and enterprise applications.
* Integrate data from:
+ NetSuite ERP
+ Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
+ Distribution Systems

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand upstream and downstream data dependencies and integration requirements. Awareness of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and emerging AI integration patterns, with an understanding of how AI agents can securely connect with enterprise data platforms such as Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW).
* Familiarity with AI/LLM concepts and AI\-enabled data access is a plus, demonstrating a forward\-looking mindset toward adopting AI capabilities within the enterprise data ecosystem.


 ETL Operations, Production Support \& Data Governance
   

  

* Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize ETL and Data Warehouse processes to meet defined SLA requirements.
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 production support for enterprise data platforms.
* Perform root cause analysis and permanent resolution for ETL failures, data discrepancies, and production incidents.
* Support 24x7 production environments, deployment activities, code releases, and emergency support requirements.
* Conduct impact assessments for source system changes and implement required enhancements.
* Define and maintain data governance, master data management, and data quality standards.
* Implement audit, reconciliation, and data validation controls across critical business processes.
* Ensure data security, compliance, retention, and regulatory requirements are met.


 Collaboration \& Technical Leadership
   

  

* Partner with Business Intelligence, ERP, Infrastructure, Finance, Supply Chain, and Application Development teams to deliver high\-quality data solutions.
* Participate in architecture discussions, solution design, project planning, effort estimation, and technical reviews.
* Mentor junior ETL developers and database professionals.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards and best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to ETL development, database performance, automation, and platform modernization.
* Create and maintain technical documentation throughout all phases of the SDLC lifecycle.
* Support Agile/Scrum delivery processes, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release management activities.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in ETL development, Data Warehousing, Data Integration, and SQL Server technologies.


 Technical Skills
   

  

 Core Data \& Database Technologies
   

  

* Microsoft SQL Server
* SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)
* SQL Server Agent and SQL Server Replication
* Change Data Capture (CDC)
* ETL/ELT Development
* Data Migration, Data Warehousing, Data Modeling
* Database Performance Tuning
* Backup \& Recovery


 Cloud \& Modern Data Platforms
   

  

* Snowflake
* Microsoft Fabric


 Integration Technologies
   

  

* REST APIs
* Web Services
* File\-Based Integrations
* ERP Integrations
* Data Synchronization \& Replication


 Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

* SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services)
* Power BI
* Enterprise Reporting \& Dashboard Development


 DevOps \& Version Control
   

  

* GitLab

 Implements and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event\-based, unstructured). Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Develops reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Develops physical data models and implements data storage architectures as per design guidelines. Analyzes complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships in order to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. Participates in testing and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses agile development technologies, such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban and continuous improvement cycle, for data driven application.

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

 Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.

 Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

 Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
   

  

 Problem Solving \- Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

 Relevant experience preferred such as working in a temporary student employment, intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities.

* Exposure to Big Data open source
* SPARK, Scala/Java, Map\-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework

Collaborates \- Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.



Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.



Customer focus \- Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer\-centric solutions.



Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.



Data Extraction \- Performs data extract\-transform\-load (ETL) activities from variety of sources and transforms them for consumption by various downstream applications and users using appropriate tools and technologies.



Programming \- Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Data Quality \- Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

* Experience developing and maintaining large\-scale ETL and ELT pipelines.
